audit: Read-only static source inspection by benchmark agent. Records final mode-specific graph loading without editing viewer source.

findings.result: Alias selects mp_app.js. ArcGIS, ngraph, Turf, legacy routing.js and eager Recast script are excluded in this mode.
Uses shared compact viewer-data promise. No nav_graph.json fetch. Lazy ensureNavmesh has a single in-flight promise; live Sweep data supplies navigation stops. Do not add a large graph download.
Shared WF.viewerData promise starts once for selected building and is reused by mp_app.js.
Regular app intentionally loads nav_graph/walkgrid/navmesh and initializes WFRouting for existing hybrid routing. Removing this graph blindly would break the map fallback.
Recast runtime download uses a shared promise; navmesh-url then existing navmesh loader handle route preparation. No large graph required merely to open Matterport.

decision: Preserve current mode-specific graph loading: Matterport already skips nav_graph; regular map fallback requires it. Separate transient-navmesh retry/resource cleanup changes are validated by the frontend agent; this audit does not claim those files are unchanged.
